title: CHAPTER ONE I BELIEVE IN GOD THE FATHER
breadcrumb: PART ONE: THE PROFESSION OF FAITH
CHAPTER ONE I BELIEVE IN GOD THE FATHER

blocks.html: Our profession of faith begins with God, for God is the First and the Last,<sup class="fn" data-fn="1">1</sup> The beginning and the end of everything. the Credo begins with God the Father, for the Father is the first divine person of the Most Holy Trinity; our Creed begins with the creation of heaven and earth, for creation is the beginning and the foundation of all God's works.
